name: io.github.77systems-ai/receipts
description: Verification for every AI agent: destination receipts, package binding, and retry laws.

environmentVariables.name: RECEIPTS_AUDIT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Local append-only audit JSONL path. Defaults to .receipts/audit.jsonl in the process working directory.

environmentVariables.name: RECEIPTS_GITHUB_REPO
environmentVariables.description: Exact GitHub owner/repo for independent issue read-back. Omit for cooperative-only use.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Local GitHub token authorized to read the configured repository. Sent only to the GitHub API for authentication.
